preconditions.description: The number of cities n is between 2 and 200,000.
Each city number u_i and v_i is between 1 and n.
Each road connects two distinct cities.
The total number of roads is n - 1.

postconditions.description: The minimum number of days needed to repair all roads is at least 1.
The minimum number of days needed to repair all roads is at most n.

postconditions.expression: Each day i has d_i >= 1 and d_i <= n - 1
postconditions.description: Each day, at least one and at most n - 1 roads are repaired.

postconditions.expression: The sum of d_i over all days i equals n - 1
postconditions.description: The total number of roads repaired over all days equals n - 1.

postconditions.expression: The roads are numbered according to the order in the input
postconditions.description: The roads are listed in the order they appear in the input.

invariants.description: Each road can be traversed in both directions.

invariants.expression: There is a unique path between any two cities
invariants.description: It is possible to travel from any city to any other city using the roads.

invariants.expression: The repair brigades cannot move between cities
invariants.description: The repair brigades are fixed in their respective cities and cannot be moved.
